newsitem.title: FRANCE: Moulinex sees improved 96/97 oper profit.
newsitem.headline: Moulinex sees improved 96/97 oper profit.

text.p: Troubled appliance maker Moulinex said on Monday it expected an improvement in operating profit for the 1996/97 year ending March 31.

"The performance was coupled with an increase in margins which were also lifted by the decline in raw materials costs, paving the way for a possible improvement in operating profit for the 1996/97 financial year," the company said in a statement with nine-month sales.
The company earlier reported nine-month sales fell down 0.9 percent to 5,901 million francs.
